description: Liquidity s5-v13: the pool map is decided by candle order alone (audit M5/M10 and the parked cluster finding, owner ruling 2026-09-14). Each mutation brings back one way the map could depend on which passes ran. The property tests are derandomized, so one battery run is a verdict. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/liquidity_map_candle_order.json

mutations.name: the dedup epsilon is the newest candle's again (M5)
a consumed pool still holds its level
a pivot's pool is born at its last confirmation, as a single pass used to stamp it
a cluster no longer merges into the pool holding its first member
mutations.old:
if level is None or not self._alive(level, joined):
            return

mutations.name: a stage applies to the candle that confirmed it
mutations.old: return max(bisect_left(stages, close_time, key=lambda stage: stage.starts) - 1, 0)
mutations.new: return max(bisect_right(stages, close_time, key=lambda stage: stage.starts) - 1, 0)

mutations.name: pools from before the window are not read back
mutations.old: records = {pool.pool_id: pool for pool in active if pool.created_at < horizon}
mutations.new: records = {pool.pool_id: pool for pool in active if False}

mutations.name: the lifecycle judges every candle against the newest stage
